product.title: Istoria ilustrată a lumii. Epoca Modernă. (Vol. 4)
product.description: În Europa, transformarea revoluţionară a sistemelor de guvernământ şi a structurilor de stat a început foarte energic: în 1789 izbucneşte la Paris Revoluţia Franceză, iar deviza sa, Liberté, Egalité, Fraternité (Libertate, Egalitate, Fraternitate) dobândeşte o forţă covârşitoare. Revoluţia Franceză a avut drept consecinţă reorganizarea fundamentală a societăţii. Ideile născute de revoluţie au apărut în Codul Civil al lui Napoleon, pe care acesta l-a impus multor naţiuni europene. Secolul XIX a cunoscut de asemenea o transformare radicală a societăţii, pornind de la altă sursă, Revoluţia Industrială, care a stabilit în cadrul ei o clasă muncitoare săracă, opusă clasei de mijloc de negustori şi de oameni de afaceri. Statele Unite ale Americii, aflate în formare, au fost zguduite de izbucnirea Războiului de Secesiune. Creşterea economică rapidă de după acest cumplit război civil a făcut din SUA, către 1900, prima putere industrială şi agricolă a lumii, care, în plan extern, a prefigurat o politică imperialistă vizând includerea unor întinse zone din vecinătate în sfera de influenţă proprie.

# Illustrated History of the World: The Modern Era (Vol. 4)

Step into the dynamic and transformative period of world history with "Illustrated History of the World: The Modern Era, Volume 4." Published by Litera, this volume provides a vivid, visually rich journey through the profound political, social, and economic shifts that reshaped Europe and the globe during the modern age. If you are looking to understand the complex tapestry woven by revolutions, industrial change, and imperial expansion, this illustrated history is an essential resource for any student or enthusiast.

## Discover the Dawn of Modernity

This volume delves into the explosive transformations that defined the shift from the older societal structures to the dynamic realities of the modern era. It chronicles how foundational eventsâsuch as the French Revolution and the subsequent Industrial Revolutionâdid not just change governments, but fundamentally altered the way humans lived, worked, and interacted across continents. By pairing detailed historical narratives with engaging illustrations, this book makes complex timelines accessible and memorable.

## Key Themes Explored in This Volume

"The Modern Era" provides an in-depth look at some of history's most pivotal moments. The narrative begins by examining the energetic transformation of European systems of government and state structures. We trace the impact of the 1789 French Revolution, exploring core ideals like *LibertÃ©, EgalitÃ©, FraternitÃ©* (Liberty, Equality, Fraternity) and how these revolutionary ideas were subsequently codified in documents like Napoleon's Civil Code, influencing numerous nations across Europe.

The book then transitions to the seismic shifts of the 19th century. A major focus is placed on the Industrial Revolution, an era that redefined human civilization through technological innovation. This section explores the creation of new social classes, specifically highlighting the emergence of the working class in opposition to the wealthy merchant and business classes. This economic upheaval laid the groundwork for modern societal divisions and political struggles.

Furthermore, the narrative extends to the rapidly changing geopolitical landscape. It covers events like the American Civil War, which marked a crucial turning point in global power dynamics. The rapid economic growth following this conflict propelled the United States into prominence, positioning it as the leading industrial and agricultural power by the turn of the 20th century. This rise directly foreshadowed the era of imperialistic policies, as these new powers sought to expand their influence and claim territories beyond their immediate borders.

## Why Choose This Illustrated History?

What sets this volume apart is its commitment to visual storytelling. The illustrations bring historical concepts to life, helping readers grasp the scale and human impact of these monumental events far more effectively than traditional text alone. It serves as an invaluable tool for visualizing complex economic shifts, political ideologies, and demographic changes that define our contemporary world. Whether you are studying history in an academic setting or seeking a compelling overview of global change, this book offers a comprehensive and engaging perspective on the Modern Era.

Explore the full illustrated story today and unlock a deeper understanding of how the modern world was built.

[Shop "Illustrated History of the World: The Modern Era, Vol. 4" here](https://www.litera.ro/istoria-ilustrata-a-lumii-epoca-moderna-vol-4)

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What historical topics are covered in this volume?**
A: This volume covers the transformative events of the Modern Era, including the French Revolution, the influence of Napoleon, the Industrial Revolution, the rise of new social classes, the American Civil War, and the emergence of imperialist policies.

**Q: Who is the target audience for this book?**
A: It is ideal for students, history enthusiasts, and anyone interested in understanding the political, economic, and social development of Europe and the world during the modern period.

**Q: Why is this edition particularly useful?**
A: The book uses illustrations to enhance historical context, making complex timelines and societal changes more engaging and easier to understand than a purely textual account.
